description: ORCHESTRATOR OVERRIDE (Jay, supersedes every mention of --cascade-trainable-init fresh below): that flag does NOT exist (see revised FEAT-002). Non-default widths (d12h, d12hs, fr50) at L1/L2 instead cascade via the normal --cascade-from path from RANDOM-WEIGHT sources at the same width built at the start of the job by FEAT-002's recipe (scratch/m11/<job>/sources/{l4_W,l2_W}; L2 grid lines use l4_W, L1 grid lines use l2_W); add their build time to the estimate and the BGR_DRY_RUN output (SOURCE lines), skip a width's grid lines with a clear status if its source build failed, and update the tests accordingly (no --cascade-trainable-init anywhere). Default-width lines keep the real m7/m8 sources. ORIGINAL: Real-trainer memory job slurm/m11_fp32_width_memory.sh (TASK 3, plan items 6-7, decision D4) + stdlib collector scripts/collect_memory_runs.py writing $PROJ/scratch/m11/<job>/fp32_width_memory.json and a table, + tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (--deform-decoder-dtype float32_fine) and FEAT-002 (--cascade-trainable-init fresh). The job is NOT submitted.
steps: scripts/collect_memory_runs.py (stdlib only, Python 3.8 syntax, no TF/numpy; docstring with usage): argparse --status STATUS_TSV --runs RUNS_DIR --out OUT_JSON [--skip-steps 2] [--job JOB]. status.tsv is tab-separated with header `name\tlevel\tdtype\twidths\tn\tmax_pairs\trc\telapsed_s\tlog`. For each row read <runs>/<name>/logs/metrics.jsonl (lines {step, time, data}; skip malformed lines; follow make_run_dir's layout, check runtime/logging.make_run_dir for the exact metrics path) and <runs>/<name>/config.json (args.filters, args.decoder_widths, param_counts.trainable, param_counts.deform_decoder). Record fields: name, level (int), dtype, widths, filters, decoder_widths, n (int), max_pairs (int), pairs (max train_deform/n_pairs or null), status, rc (int), elapsed_s, steps_logged (records with time/compute_ms), gpu_peak_mb (max gpu_peak_mb or null), gpu_peak_gib (/1024, 2 decimals), mean_deform_step_s, mean_linear_step_s ((time/data_ms + time/compute_ms)/1000 averaged over records with step > skip_steps; a record is linear iff any data key starts with 'train_rigid/' or 'train_affine/', else deform; null if none), nonfinite_total (last record value), param_count, deform_decoder_params, error (last log line containing 'Error' or 'error', stripped, <= 300 chars, null if none). status: rc == -1 -> 'skipped_time'; rc in (124, 137) -> 'timeout'; log text contains 'ResourceExhaustedError' or 'OOM when allocating' or 'out of memory' -> 'oom'; rc == 0 and steps_logged > 0 -> 'ok'; else 'abort'. Write {'job': job, 'skip_steps': k, 'records': [...]} with indent 1; print a fixed-width table (name, lvl, dtype, widths, N, pairs, status, peak GiB, deform s, linear s, params M). Exit 2 if the status file is missing, else 0.

tests/test_collect_memory_runs.py (no TF; unittest + tempfile): build fake runs (metrics.jsonl with steps 1..8 incl. gpu_peak_mb, time/data_ms, time/compute_ms, train_deform/n_pairs; config.json with args + param_counts) and logs; assert: ok record (peak = max, mean deform step skips steps 1-2, pairs, params), oom by log text with rc 1, timeout rc 124, skipped_time rc -1, abort (rc 134, no OOM text), a missing run directory -> nulls and status from rc/log, linear-record classification, table printed, missing status file exit 2. Load the module via importlib from scripts/ (pattern of tests/test_sweep_tools.py / summarize_runs tests).
tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: add scripts/collect_memory_runs.py to PYFILES, tests.test_collect_memory_runs to the TF-free names list, slurm/m11_fp32_width_memory.sh to the bash -n loop.

slurm/m11_fp32_width_memory.sh (ASCII, LF, executable bit not required): SBATCH lines exactly `#SBATCH --job-name=bgr-m11-fp32w`, `#SBATCH -A qtim`, `#SBATCH -p rtx8000`, `#SBATCH --gpus=1`, `#SBATCH -N 1`, `#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=1`, `#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=3`, `#SBATCH --mem=64G`, `#SBATCH --time=04:00:00`, `#SBATCH --output=/autofs/space/crater_001/users/jn85/BrainRegProjects/GroupwiseReg/logs/%x-%j.out`, `#SBATCH --error=/autofs/space/crater_001/users/jn85/BrainRegProjects/GroupwiseReg/logs/%x-%j.err`. Header comments: purpose (Jay's decision: fp32 deform decoder at all levels + narrower widths), dtype modes, the width table (default: no width flags; d12h; d12hs; fr50 = preset), why non-default widths use --cascade-trainable-init fresh (random trainable stage, frozen stages from the sources, memory/time only), the recipe, previous numbers (m9 phase 1 tool: L1 deform N4 default 31.0 GB, f0d1 29.7, fr50 29.3 at 1 pair; trainer smoke 10518446 fp16 4 pairs 38.5 GB without lean losses; long run 10518952 with lean losses 36.7 GB first window), the time estimate and split rule (below), output paths, 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval (pre-approved once fp32-decoder-width lands); at most two active jobs; account qtim only', `mkdir -p .../logs` note and the submit line `sbatch slurm/m11_fp32_width_memory.sh`. Do NOT write the forbidden account name anywhere (static test).

Script body: `set -uo pipefail`; env defaults PROJ, REPO=$PROJ/brain-group-rad, DATA=$PROJ/data/npy_v2, SRC_RESULTS=$PROJ/results, SIF, JOB_ID=${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}, SCRATCH_ROOT=/scratch, L1_SOURCE=$SRC_RESULTS/m8_level2_gradnorm/ckpt/best, L2_SOURCE=$SRC_RESULTS/m7_three_task_lncc/ckpt/best, STEPS=8, CONFIG_TIMEOUT=2400, TIME_BUDGET_S=13800, ONLY='', BGR_DRY_RUN=''. die()/need_uint validation (STEPS >= 3, CONFIG_TIMEOUT, TIME_BUDGET_S); source guard: each of L1_SOURCE / L2_SOURCE must be a directory or have <prefix>.index (only the sources needed by the selected configs; also in dry run). Width args: W_default='', W_d12h='--decoder-widths 128,96,64,16,8', W_d12hs='--filters 16,64,128,192,256,384 --decoder-widths 128,96,64,16,8', W_fr50='--filters 16,32,128,192,256,384 --decoder-widths 128,96,64,16,8'. Dtype tags f16 -> float16, f32 -> float32, f32fine -> float32_fine. COMMON args: --data "$DATA" --results "$RUNS" --resume false --task-ratio deform:1 --steps "$STEPS" --val-every 0 --ckpt-every 0 --warmup-steps 0 --log-every 1 --log-backend jsonl --val-png false --global-transform false --curriculum false --optimizer adamw --lr 3e-4 --weight-decay 0 --task-grad-norm 12 --lambda-dice-template 1 --lambda-pdice 1 --lambda-ncc-template 1 --lambda-ncc-pair 1 --lambda-smooth 0.5 --p-pair 0.1 --p-pdice 0.1 --min-pairs n --bn-recal-batches 0 --amp true --gradient-checkpointing full --lean-sampler true --split-group-conv true --intensity-aug-device tf --lowres-method tent --num-threads ${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-3} --prefetch 1. Check each flag name exists in runtime/args.py (e.g. --schedule default, --prefetch) and that `main.py --help` lists it; drop or rename any that does not. Level args: L1 `--level 1 --cascade-from $L1_SOURCE --group-size 4 --deform-group-size 4 --pair-recompute true --lean-losses true --gpu-memory-limit-mb 40000 --val-image-chunk 1 --val-pair-chunk 1`; L2 `--level 2 --cascade-from $L2_SOURCE --group-size 16 --deform-group-size 16 --max-pairs 64 --pair-recompute false --val-pair-chunk 4`; L4 `--level 4 --group-size 64 --deform-group-size 64 --max-pairs 64 --pair-recompute false --val-pair-chunk 16`. Non-default widths at L1/L2 append `--cascade-trainable-init fresh`. Verify locally that one generated L1, L2 and L4 argv parses: `python -c 'from runtime import args as A; A.parse_args([...])'` in bgr_preproc38 (runtime.args imports without TF) with dummy paths, and turn that into a test (see test step).

Config list (ordered, 20 names, format <level>_<dtype tag>_<width>): l1_f32fine_default l1_f32_default l1_f32fine_d12h l1_f32_d12h l1_f32fine_d12hs l1_f32_d12hs l1_f32fine_fr50 l1_f32_fr50 l1_f16_default l1_f16_d12h l1_f16_d12hs l1_f16_fr50 l2_f32fine_default l2_f32_default l2_f32fine_d12h l2_f32_d12h l4_f32fine_default l4_f32_default l4_f32fine_d12h l4_f32_d12h. ONLY filters this list (unknown names -> exit 2). N / max_pairs per level for the status row: L1 4 / 0, L2 16 / 64, L4 64 / 64.

BGR_DRY_RUN=1: after validation print `CONFIG <name>: python main.py <args...> --run-name <name> --deform-decoder-dtype <dtype>` per selected config and `COLLECT: python scripts/collect_memory_runs.py --status ... --runs ... --out .../fp32_width_memory.json --job $JOB_ID`, exit 0, no mkdir, no singularity.

Real run: OUT_DIR=$PROJ/scratch/m11/$JOB_ID, RUNS=$OUT_DIR/runs, STATUS=$OUT_DIR/status.tsv (header written first); mkdir -p $RUNS $PROJ/scratch/keras $PROJ/scratch/cuda_cache; TMPDIR=$SCRATCH_ROOT/$JOB_ID + SINGULARITYENV_TMPDIR / KERAS_HOME / CUDA_CACHE_PATH / PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE exports as in slurm/m9_level1_cascade.sh; cd $REPO; echo host/job/git rev/date and nvidia-smi line. Loop: elapsed=$((SECONDS)); if elapsed + 300 > TIME_BUDGET_S -> append row with rc -1 and continue; t=min(CONFIG_TIMEOUT, TIME_BUDGET_S - elapsed); `timeout "$t" singularity exec --nv -B /scratch -B /autofs -B /cluster -B /space -B /vast "$SIF" python main.py ... > "$RUNS/$name.log" 2>&1 </dev/null; rc=$?`; append row (name level dtype widths n max_pairs rc elapsed_s log); echo '=== <name> rc <rc> <secs> s'; on rc != 0 echo `tail -n 5` of the log; `rm -rf "$RUNS/$name/ckpt"`. After the loop: `singularity exec -B /autofs -B /cluster -B /space "$SIF" python scripts/collect_memory_runs.py --status "$STATUS" --runs "$RUNS" --out "$OUT_DIR/fp32_width_memory.json" --job "$JOB_ID" </dev/null`; exit with the collector's exit code (OOM / abort / timeout configs are results, not job failures).

Header time estimate (write it into the comments): L1 config that runs ~9-10 min (startup with DALI, level-1 validation sets, model builds and the frozen chain restore ~4-5 min; first deform step trace + autotune ~2-3 min; 7 more steps at ~25-45 s), an OOM ~4 min -> 12 L1 configs ~1.8-2.0 h; L2 N16 ~5 min x 4; L4 N64 ~4 min x 4 -> ~2.6 h of 4 h. Guard: configs that would start after TIME_BUDGET_S - 300 (3h45m) are recorded as skipped_time. Split rule: if any are skipped, rerun them with `ONLY=<names> sbatch --time=02:00:00 slurm/m11_fp32_width_memory.sh` (results go to a new job directory).
